verdict.rationale: SerpApi is a hosted SaaS search API, so whether its source is readable under an open license is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows only public GitHub repos for client libraries and an MCP server, and none of it states a license. Nothing indicates the core SerpApi service source is published under an open license; the client SDKs are an adjacent artifact, not the product's own source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
